items.title: Multi-Part Posts
items.body: Posts that bundle more than one video now show a parts picker on iPhone and iPad, and a Parts sidebar on Apple TV.

items.title: Closed Captions
items.body: Floatplane's auto-generated captions now play on iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV. Toggle them from the CC button next to the rotate control.

items.title: Reply to Comments
items.body: Tap Reply under any top-level comment to thread your reply right from the player.

items.title: Accurate Card Durations
items.body: Multi-part posts show the primary clip's length instead of the sum of every part, with a small +N badge when there are extras.

items.title: iOS 17 + tvOS 17 Support
items.body: FloatNative now runs on iOS 17 and tvOS 17 devices in addition to 18+.

items.title: Playback Polish
items.body: iPad audio now stops when you back out of a video, landscape rotation no longer flashes black, and the resolution label sits cleanly under the gear.
